questions.questionText: What is the main purpose of Spring Boot auto-configuration?
options: A. To replace the Java compiler
B. To configure beans based on dependencies and application settings
C. To create database tables manually
questions.correctAnswer: B. To configure beans based on dependencies and application settings
questions.explanation: Auto-configuration configures the application according to its classpath and settings.

questions.questionText: Which annotation is normally used for a business service class?
questions.explanation: @Service communicates the business-service role of the component.

questions.questionText: Which HTTP method is normally used to create a resource?
questions.explanation: POST is commonly used to create a subordinate resource.
